description: Give the user or another agent a file or a secret WITHOUT it passing through this chat. Works for large files (folders, dumps, exports, builds, videos — free up to a limit, more after one card payment by the user). Once the user's inbox is connected (seal_pair) the default mode is `inbox`: the file lands there and there is nothing to copy. Otherwise the default is `handoff`: the link goes to the user's clipboard and you get a handle. Where there is no clipboard it goes to a 0600 file and you get its path: do not read that file and do not print it. Mode `forward`: a link only the agent with the given SEAL address can open — use it for another agent. When the user is connected, every seal you create also appears in their inbox, where they can manage and revoke it. Never paste secrets or huge content into the chat instead.

expire.description: How long the link lives: one of `limits.json::ttl_options`. Default 5m; in handoff mode a file or folder over 100 MB defaults to 1d. Forward mode allows at most 30m. Above the free limit (a paid tier): 1d or 7d, default 1d.

max_reads.description: Maximum number of downloads. Forward mode locks this to 1.

mime.description: Override the auto-detected MIME type (encrypted into the metadata bundle; drives the recipient's inline-render whitelist).

mode.description: Where the link goes. Without it: `inbox` when this agent is connected to the user's inbox (seal_pair, or SEAL_OWNER), else `handoff`. `inbox` needs a connected owner (`owner_not_paired` otherwise) and takes no `to`.

path.description: Absolute path to the file or folder to share. A folder is sent as one `<folder>.zip` of its regular files (symlinks are skipped). The server streams it from disk; you never read the content yourself. Required unless `payment` is given.

payment.description: Handle of a share waiting for its payment: wait for it and finish the upload.

tier.description: Above the free limit only: the tier the user pays for once by card, a code of `limits.json::SEAL_TIERS` (prices and terms: seal.net/pricing). Default: the smallest that fits.

to.description: The recipient's SEAL address (43 characters: `sealnet-mcp pubkey`, `seal keygen`). REQUIRED for mode=forward; not read in mode=handoff. Refused in mode=inbox: the address there is the connected owner.

name: seal_share
title: Share a file via SEAL
